passage.label: Except the chosen servants of Allah; for them a provision determined, fruits, and they are honored in gardens of pleasure on thrones facing one another; circulated among them a cup from a flowing spring, white and delicious to the drinkers, no bad effect in it nor intoxication; with them women limiting their glances with large beautiful eyes as if delicate well-protected eggs; they approach one another inquiring; a speaker says I had a companion who asked are you of those who believe, that when we are dust and bones we will be recompensed; would you care to look; he looks and sees him in the midst of the Hellfire; by Allah you almost ruined me; if not for the favor of my Lord I would have been among those brought in; are we not to die except our first death and not be punished; this is the great attainment; for the like of this let the workers work; is Paradise a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqum; We made it a torment for the wrongdoers, a tree issuing from the bottom of Hellfire, its emerging fruit as if heads of devils; they eat from it and fill their bellies, then a mixture of scalding water, then their return is to the Hellfire; they found their fathers astray and hastened in their footsteps; most of the former peoples had strayed before them and We sent warners among them; look how was the end of those warned, except the chosen servants; Noah called Us and We are the best of responders; We saved him and his family from the great affliction and made his descendants those remaining; left favorable mention among later generations; peace upon Noah among the worlds; thus We reward the doers of good; he was of Our believing servants; then We drowned the disbelievers

arabicExcerpts.text: لَا فِيهَا غَوۡلٞ وَلَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا يُنزَفُونَ
قَالَ قَآئِلٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ إِنِّي كَانَ لِي قَرِينٞ
أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
وَلَوۡلَا نِعۡمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡضَرِينَ
إِلَّا مَوۡتَتَنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
أَذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٞ نُّزُلًا أَمۡ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٞ تَخۡرُجُ فِيٓ أَصۡلِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
فَإِنَّهُمۡ لَأٓكِلُونَ مِنۡهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنۡهَا ٱلۡبُطُونَ
ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمۡ عَلَيۡهَا لَشَوۡبٗا مِّنۡ حَمِيمٖ

mainSubject.label: Chosen servants exempted from punishment with determined provision, fruits and honor in gardens of pleasure; throne-facing fellowship and a circulating cup free of harm and intoxication; glance-restricted companions described as protected eggs; the inquiry scene contrasting a believer with his former mocking companion now seen in Hellfire, and the acknowledgment that only divine favor prevented ruin; single-death security declared the great attainment for which workers should work; the zaqqum tree contrasted with Paradise as torment issuing from Hellfire's base with devil-head fruit and scalding mixture; ancestral haste in misguidance and the fate of warned nations; Nuh's call answered by rescue from great affliction, survival through his descendants, lasting mention, universal peace and the muhsin reward formula, followed by the drowning of the disbelievers
